🚨 BREAKING NEWS

UIU Owner Banned From Main Server Following Inappropriate Remarks, Cross-Banned From Multiple Factions

The owner of UIU has been banned from the main Build & Conquer server and subsequently cross-banned from multiple factions he was previously associated with.

According to a moderator who confirmed the incident, the bans followed a sexually inappropriate comment made by the UIU owner, which also resulted in UIU being shut down.

These developments have been confirmed to BCBN by a moderator.

Source: Moderator @SLOP STAFF | findog

Banned Faction GOC Allegedly Involved in Creating Anti-Staff Faction

Reports have emerged alleging that GOC, a previously banned faction in Build & Conquer, is involved in establishing a faction targeting members of The Slop Company staff.

The allegations suggest that the faction may be intended to express hostility towards the game’s staff team. However, BCBN has not independently verified these claims.

GOC’s response to the allegations has not yet been confirmed.
